intro_zh: 本課學習把兩個名詞合併成一個新名詞，例如 living room、dining room、bedroom，這樣就能說出房子裡的不同空間。我們將透過圖片和短文，看見每個房間裡有什麼家具，並練習說出它們的名字。
can_do: 能說出 living room、dining room、bedroom 等複合名詞。
能描述自己家裡的房間和家具，並用正確的詞彙說明位置。
能閱讀簡短的家庭情境短文，理解主要意思並回答簡單問題。

sentences.en: Tom lives in a small apartment on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 湯姆住在二樓的小公寓裡。

sentences.en: He likes to fix the lamp in the living room.
sentences.zh: 他喜歡修理客廳裡的檯燈。

sentences.en: The living room has a big window and a soft carpet on the floor.
sentences.zh: 客廳有一扇大窗戶，地板上鋪著軟軟的地毯。

sentences.en: In the kitchen, his mother cooks dinner and sometimes she bakes a cake.
sentences.zh: 廚房裡，他的媽媽煮晚餐，有時她會烤蛋糕。

sentences.en: He knocks on the door before he enters the bathroom.
The bathroom has a white wall, a small fan, and a clean floor.
sentences.zh: 浴室有白色牆壁、小風扇和乾淨的地板。

sentences.en: Next to the apartment is a small garden with colorful flowers and green grass.
sentences.zh: 公寓旁邊有一個小花園，裡面有彩色的花和綠草地。

sentences.en: His bedroom is upstairs, and it has a cozy bed and a lamp on the nightstand.
sentences.zh: 他的臥室在樓上，裡面有舒適的床和床頭燈。

sentences.en: Tom feels happy because his home is warm and full of love.
sentences.zh: 湯姆感到很幸福，因為他的家溫暖且充滿愛。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① 複合名詞的三種寫法
grammar_points.explain_zh: 複合名詞可以分開寫、連起來寫或加連字號。意思不變，只是寫法不同。

grammar_points.title_zh: ② 複合名詞變複數時只有後面那個字變
grammar_points.explain_zh: 當複合名詞變成複數時，只把後面的名詞加 -s 或 -es，前面的字不變。

examples.en: The hotel has three dining rooms.
She bought new bedrooms for the house.
examples.zh: 她為房子買了新的臥房。

lines.en: The dining room is next to the kitchen.
The house has a big garden.

sentences.en: The living room has a soft sofa and a bright lamp.
sentences.zh: 客廳有柔軟的沙發和亮亮的檯燈。

sentences.en: We eat dinner in the dining room every night.
sentences.zh: 我們每晚在餐廳吃晚餐。

sentences.en: My bedroom is small but cozy.
sentences.zh: 我的臥房雖小但很舒適。

sentences.en: The apartment has two bedrooms and one bathroom.
sentences.zh: 這棟公寓有兩間臥房和一間浴室。

sentences.en: Please knock on the door before you enter the room.
The lamp on the wall gives warm light.
sentences.zh: 牆上的檯燈發出暖暖的光。

sentences.en: We planted flowers in the garden behind the house.
sentences.zh: 我們在房子後面的花園種了花。

sentences.en: The floor of the kitchen is made of wood.
sentences.zh: 廚房的地板是木頭做的。

grammar: 兩個名詞合起來變成一個東西的名字：living room、dining room、bedroom。

mcq.q: We watch TV in the ______. (客廳)
The children sleep in the ______. (臥室)
I eat dinner in the ______. (餐廳)
If you want to go in, please ______ the door. (敲)

fill.q: The lamp is ____ the wall.（燈在牆上。）
They ____ in the living room.（他們在客廳裡。）
The lamp is ____ the floor。（燈在地板下。）
We ____ the fan。（我們修理風扇。）
She likes to ____ in the garden。（她喜歡在花園裡走。）
The ____ is in the house。（燈在房子裡。）
The lamp ____ on the wall.（燈在牆上。）
This is my ____。（這是我的房間。）

translate.ans: I want to fix the fan.
She likes to go in the garden.
The lamp is on the floor.
We are in the living room.
I want to fix the lamp.

unscramble.q: The / is / the / on / floor / . / lamp
unscramble.ans: The lamp is on the floor.

unscramble.q: the / . / in / room / You / living / are
unscramble.ans: You are in the living room.
